finalText:
**Redis died and took prod with it.** One cause, not a mess.

| Time | Event |
|---|---|
| 02:14:07 | `redis connection lost: ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379` |
| 02:14:08 | Cache bypassed. Reads hit the store direct |
| 02:29:12 | Queue depth `502` passes max `500` |
| 02:31:44 | `worker-2` heap out of memory, code `134` |
| 02:31:52 | `api unresponsive, killing process group — service down` |

The 173 `TimeoutError` and 174 cache miss lines are all downstream noise. Redis never came back. All 13 reconnects failed, spaced a flat 80s apart, so the retry has no backoff and no cap.

Next: check why `10.0.0.12:6379` refused connections. Then cap the queue so a cache outage sheds load instead of eating heap.
